lines.en: show futabachappy
hide futabacsiappointed
: Or just use your shirt to wipe everything off.
lines.zh: : 或者干脆用你的衬衫把身上擦干净。

lines.en: : What? No. Don’t do that. Never do that.
lines.zh: : 什么？不行。别那样做。永远别那样。

lines.en: : Then warn me next time at least...
lines.zh: : 那下次至少提前警告我一下……

lines.en: Next time...
lines.zh: 下次……

lines.en: Fuck yeah.
lines.zh: 太他妈的值了。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. I will. Sorry about that.
lines.zh: : 好好好，我会的。抱歉啦。

lines.en: : I do have to say, though, you did look really cute with all of that-
lines.zh: : 不过我得说，你沾满那东西的样子真的很可爱——

lines.en: show futabacembarrassed
hide futabachappy
: S-Sensei! Don’t even think of finishing that sentence!
lines.zh: : 老、老师！你别想把那句话说完！

lines.en: scene black
with dissolve2
Futaba and I talk for a while longer before it’s time for me to head home.
lines.zh: 我和 Futaba 又聊了一会儿，才到了我该回家的时候。

lines.en: She immediately grabs a change of clothes and follows me out into the hall.
lines.zh: 她立刻抓过一套换洗衣服，跟着我走到走廊上。

lines.en: We walk toward the exit together, and she eventually splits off to go to the shower room.
lines.zh: 我们一起朝出口走去，最后她拐向了淋浴间。

lines.en: I think it’s safe to say that Futaba is finally comfortable with me.
lines.zh: 我想可以肯定地说，Futaba 终于和我相处自在了。

lines.en: "Sure...she’s had a crush on {s}Sensei{/s} me for a while now, but it’s still crazy thinking of
lines.zh: "当然……她暗恋{s}老师{/s}我已经有一阵子了，

lines.en: how far she’s come in such a short amount of time."
lines.zh: 但想想她在这么短的时间里走了这么远，还是觉得不可思议。"

lines.en: And I still barely know anything about her...
lines.zh: 而我依然几乎不了解她……

lines.en: Oh well, I guess it's not really a big deal.
lines.zh: 算了，我想这也没什么大不了的。

lines.en: I should get back home and get to sleep if I want to wake up at a reasonable hour tomorrow...
lines.zh: 要是明天还想在一个像样的时间起床，我就该回家睡觉了……
